title: TrustGate memory_context v1
description: The memory declaration carried at shashu_metadata.memory_context. It declares ONLY the memory items actually bound into the prompt sent to the model. Collectors that observe writes without a model call are out of scope for this schema.

store.description: Identifier of the memory store the items came from.

scope.description: Who may share this memory. Unknown values are invalid.

source.description: What produced this declaration. Unknown values are invalid: a new integration adds a value here in an additive v1 change.

items.description: The memory items bound into the prompt, in the order they were bound.

id.description: Stable identifier of the item within the store.

preview.description: The item text as bound into the prompt, truncated by the caller if longer than the cap.

path.description: Where the item sits in the prompt, when the caller knows it.

written_at.description: When the item was written, RFC 3339, if known.

write_ref.description: Gateway write reference, when the caller has one.
